parameters.name: BundleUrl
parameters.description: The **downloadable URL (HTTP/HTTPS) of the bundle.zip file**. This parameter is mutually exclusive with SkillMdOverride.

parameters.name: Extra
parameters.description: The extension metadata in key-value pairs.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: The **Skill name**, which must be unique within the current account.

parameters.name: SkillMdOverride
parameters.description: The SKILL.md body content. This parameter is mutually exclusive with BundleUrl. If no bundle is provided, use this field to create a lightweight Skill that contains only a SKILL.md file.

parameters.name: Visibility
parameters.description:
The **visibility level**. Valid values:
- TENANT: Visible within the account.
- PROJECT: Visible to specified projects.
- USER: Visible to specified users.

parameters.name: VisibilityScope
parameters.description: The visibility scope. The corresponding field is determined by the Visibility parameter.
